from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

spreadsheet_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/38332/1_38332_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/38332_0_d46409ee/1_38332_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Build the set of nonblank values appearing in column A below the header.
values_in_a = set()
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    val = ws.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if val is not None and val != "":
        values_in_a.add(val)

# For each listed unique value in C2:C5, return 1 if it occurs in column A, else 0.
# This is the literal equivalent of: =--(COUNTIF($A:$A,C2)>0)
for row in range(2, 6):
    lookup_val = ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value
    ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value = 1 if lookup_val in values_in_a else 0

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Verification
check_wb = load_workbook(output_path, data_only=True)
check_ws = check_wb["Sheet1"]
print([check_ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value for r in range(2, 6)])
